text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Spring Stakes, Rice Shower worries she won't be able to catch up to Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her life as a racer has just begun. With her feelings in check, she heads out to test her abilities in her first real race.
